entities.name: Erik Pfeifer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Erik Pfeifer is a German professional boxer who has held the WBO European heavyweight title since 2019. As an amateur he won bronze medals at the 2011 and 2013 World Championships and competed in the 2012 and 2016 Olympics.
